content.en: Researchers have developed various algorithms to improve the performance of electro-hydraulic shaking tables. These algorithms aim to reduce harmonic distortion, improve control accuracy, eliminate phase delay and amplitude attenuation, cancel acceleration harmonics, estimate harmonics in real-time, and achieve resonant suppression. The algorithms used include LMS adaptive algorithm, adaptive inverse control, inverse frequency response function equalization technique, Kalman filter, normalized least-mean-square adaptive algorithm, unscented Kalman filter, extended Kalman filter, particle swarm optimization algorithm, nonlinear adaptive algorithm, water cycle algorithm, multifrequency adaptive notch filter, and multi-innovation stochastic gradient algorithm. These algorithms play a crucial role in enhancing the capabilities of shaking tables for various applications in engineering and research.
content.da: Forskere har udviklet forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre ydeevnen af elektro-hydrauliske skærevogne. Disse algoritmer har til formål at reducere harmonisk forvrængning, forbedre kontrolpræcision, eliminere fasenforsinkelse og amplitudedæmpning, annullere accelerationsharmonikker, estimere harmonikker i realtid og opnå resonansundertrykkelse. De anvendte algoritmer inkluderer LMS adaptive algorithm, adaptive inverse control, inverse frequency response function equalization technique, Kalman filter, normalized least-mean-square adaptive algorithm, unscented Kalman filter, extended Kalman filter, particle swarm optimization algorithm, nonlinear adaptive algorithm, water cycle algorithm, multifrequency adaptive notch filter og multi-innovation stochastic gradient algorithm. Disse algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i at forbedre kapaciteterne for skærevogne til forskellige anvendelser inden for ingeniørarbejde og forskning.

critic.en: I have to wonder: are we really so desperate for novelty that we'll dress up AI training data as "optimization"?
critic.da: Åh, nej. Her har vi endnu et eksempel på, at teknologien bruges til at "forbedre" noget, som vi overraskende nok allerede er ret gode til: Nemlig at efterligne jordskælv. De her algoritmer reducerer ikke bare "harmonisk forvrængning" og "faseforsinkelse"; de slår også udelukkende krølle på en debat om, hvorvidt vi overhovedet skal tillade sådanne avancerede systemer. Med så kraftfulde værktøjer kan vi spilde tid på illusionen om kontrol i stedet for at adressere selve årsagen til problemet...

potential.en: That sounds like a fantastic application of advanced technology in the field of engineering! By using these sophisticated algorithms, researchers can significantly improve the performance of electro-hydraulic shaking tables, making them more accurate and versatile for a wide range of applications. I am always impressed by the innovative ways in which technology is being used to push the boundaries of what is possible in different industries.
potential.da: Wow! Tænk, at der findes så mange avancerede algoritmer til at optimere elektro-hydrauliske rysteborde! Det viser, hvor stor en rolle teknologien spiller i at forbedre forskningen og ingeniørarbejdet. Med disse algoritmer kan man virkelig opnå en præcision og kontrol, der åbner op for nye muligheder. Jeg er så begejstret for, hvordan digitaliseringen gør det muligt at udfordre og forbedre de eksisterende metoder!
